chars.TEEN: TEEN: a skinny Moroccan teenage boy wearing a faded red hoodie with one white stripe across the chest, worn blue jeans, old white sneakers, a small paint-stained canvas backpack.
chars.PAINTER: PAINTER: a tall older Moroccan painter wearing a long beige linen coat over a black turtleneck, round gold-rimmed glasses, a grey flat cap and a colorful paint-stained scarf.
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a chubby teenage boy wearing a bright yellow football jersey and black track pants.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Open-air art exhibition in an old Rabat street with white and blue walls and framed canvases on easels. The PAINTER stands close in front of the TEEN, looking down at him intensely with crossed arms; the TEEN looks up at him, surprised and nervous. Tense face-off.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Open-air art exhibition in an old Rabat street, white and blue walls, colorful abstract canvases on easels. The TEEN and the FRIEND stand in front of a big colorful painting, the TEEN amazed with wide eyes and open mouth, the FRIEND bored eating sunflower seeds.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same street exhibition in Rabat. In the foreground the PAINTER, standing among visitors next to his paintings, turns his head and notices the TEEN in the background, who is smiling with pure joy at a painting. Curious look from the PAINTER.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same street exhibition in Rabat. The PAINTER walks up to the TEEN and leans toward him, asking a question with one open hand; the TEEN, surprised, points at himself shyly.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same street exhibition in Rabat. The PAINTER and the TEEN stand side by side in front of the PAINTER's large colorful canvas on an easel; the PAINTER gestures proudly at the painting, the TEEN stares at it in awe.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same street exhibition in Rabat. The TEEN talks passionately to the PAINTER, both hands raised as if describing a dream, eyes shining; the PAINTER listens with raised eyebrows, hand on his chin.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same street exhibition in Rabat. The PAINTER, serious and stern, wags one finger at the TEEN as if giving a hard lesson; the TEEN looks down, embarrassed, hands in his hoodie pocket.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Same street exhibition in Rabat. The PAINTER points firmly at his big canvas on an easel and stares at the TEEN with a challenging look; the TEEN, sweating and nervous, slowly shakes his head. Dramatic tension.
